item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"spatial_sites","expression":"x.shape[0] * x.shape[3] * x.shape[4]","rationale":"Captures spatial convolution, padding, normalization, and cached-frame copying costs."},{"name":"input_sites","expression":"x.shape[0] * x.shape[2] * x.shape[3] * x.shape[4]","rationale":"Captures convolution and elementwise work that scales with the input chunk's temporal length."},{"name":"attention_pairs","expression":"x.shape[0] * (x.shape[3] // 8) ** 2 * (x.shape[4] // 8) ** 2","rationale":"Captures quadratic spatial attention work at the encoder bottleneck, which has one temporal frame in this workload."},{"name":"warm_cache","expression":"int(feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None)","rationale":"Distinguishes initial chunks from subsequent chunks with cached concatenations and temporal downsampling."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is explained by spatial work, temporal-volume work, bottleneck attention pairs, and the fixed overhead of processing a populated feature cache."}
